title: Bilingual ANVISA Regulatory RAG Prototype
description: Archived-corpus bilingual ANVISA regulatory RAG prototype and reproducibility evidence. Version v0.2.1 retains the coauthor-reviewed 3 November 2026 manuscript revision, clean and tracked documents, full reviewer response, figures, curated question-level data, separate human and AI assessments, and matched hybrid/BM25/model-only comparisons. Coauthor-rated content success is 39/40 hybrid, 38/40 BM25 and 9/40 model-only answers; bilingual success is 19/20, 18/20 and 4/20 pairs. The hybrid-BM25 difference is inconclusive. All 118 distinct new answers (120 condition records) received personal coauthor review, with prior project exposure and limited condition masking disclosed. Historical scores, problematic source references, negative results and disagreements are retained separately. This does not establish current-law accuracy, fresh independent external validation or professional workflow benefit. Full ANVISA corpora, indexes, credentials and concealed reviewer coordination keys are excluded. This patch adds the GPEC affiliation for both manuscript authors, corrects supplementary direct-article category labels, clarifies tokenizer units and sibling-test denominators, and includes the recovered numeric source CSVs for Supplementary Tables S14 and S15. Scientific scores are unchanged from v0.2.0.
